```{r}
library(tidyverse)
Tremblant1 <- read.csv("emiliaagostinelli/module_1/Tremblant1.csv")
```

```{r}
Tremblant_diff <- Tremblant1 |>
  mutate(Time_Diff = Run1_Time - Run2_Time)
```

```{r}
write.csv(Tremblant_diff, file = "emiliaagostinelli/module_1/Tremblant_diff.csv")
```
